items.exampleEn: We crossed a small stream on the way.
items.exampleZh: 我們在路上越過一條小溪。

items.exampleEn: Farmers grow different crops in summer and winter.
items.exampleZh: 農夫們在夏天和冬天種不同的農作物。

items.exampleEn: The lights went out, and the room was in darkness.
She wrote a phone number on her palm.
items.exampleZh: 她把電話號碼寫在手掌上。

items.exampleEn: Organic vegetables are usually more expensive.
Most of the land here is agricultural.
items.exampleZh: 這裡大部分的土地是農業用地。

items.exampleEn: Many animals are losing their natural habitat.
items.exampleZh: 許多動物正在失去牠們的自然棲息地。

items.exampleEn: The summit is covered with snow all year.

items.sentenceEn: This agricultural town is famous for its apples.
items.sentenceZh: 這個農業小鎮以蘋果聞名。

items.audioEn: Climbers should reach the summit before three, because it gets dark early in winter.
items.audioZh: 登山客應該在三點前登頂，因為冬天天黑得早。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要在三點前登頂？
options: It gets cold early in winter

items.sentenceEn: Some animals can see well in darkness.
items.sentenceZh: 有些動物在黑暗中看得很清楚。

items.sentenceEn: We drank cold water from the stream.

items.stemEn: Rice is the main ____ in this area.
items.stemZh: 稻米是這個地區的主要農作物。

items.stemEn: He held the tiny bird in the ____ of his hand.
items.stemZh: 他把那隻小鳥捧在手掌心。

items.passageEn: My uncle is a farmer in an agricultural area in the south. He grows organic vegetables and rice. A small stream runs through his farm, and it is a habitat for frogs and fish. Last year, we climbed to the summit of the hill behind his farm to watch the sunrise. We started in total darkness at four in the morning. At the top, he put some seeds in the palm of my hand and said, "Plant these when you get home." Later, I wrote about his farm for a school assignment.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔是南部一個農業地區的農夫。他種有機蔬菜和稻米。一條小溪流過他的農場，是青蛙和魚的棲息地。去年，我們爬上他農場後面的山丘頂端看日出。我們凌晨四點在一片漆黑中出發。到了山頂，他在我的手心放了一些種子，說：「回家後把這些種下去。」後來，我把他的農場寫成學校的作業。

questions.questionZh: 農場裡的小溪是什麼動物的棲息地？
叔叔在作者的手心放了什麼？

referenceEn: My mother only buys organic fruit.
My mom buys only organic fruit.
rubricZh: organic 表示「有機的」，例如 organic fruit 等說法

items.promptZh: 從山頂可以看到整座城市。
referenceEn: You can see the whole city from the summit.
From the summit, you can see the entire city.
